output.objection: You are proposing to run a heavier model in production without acknowledging the direct hit to our compute budget. I need that cost increase explicitly on the table before we discuss any potential uplift.
output.correction: I am not saying we cannot spend more, I am saying the trade off must be visible and monitored. Do not file this as a hard budget freeze, because I am willing to accept higher spend if the model proves it reduces residual stock and waste.
